about: The 10-day launch schedule, read by the 4:00 IST run. Times are IST. Build only the items for the run's own day. Clinical posts come from the 70-topic cycle (publish/post-NN, manifest.json). Product posts are built from the copy below with design/build_product.py (cards) or design/build_video.py --spec (Reels), in light looks only (editorial, notecard, chart), and saved under publish/product/<slug>/. Product numbers are rounded down and were checked on 23 Oct: 7,500+ questions, 2,500+ Next Gen, 100+ case studies, 4,000+ flashcards, 400+ lessons. Recount before using any number, and never print the exact count.

formats.card: IG post (feed.jpg) + FB post (feed.jpg) at 06:00, IG and FB Story (story.jpg) at 07:00
formats.carousel: IG post with slide1..5 + FB post with slide1..5 at 06:00, Story (story.jpg) at 07:00
formats.reel: IG Reel + FB Reel + YouTube Short (short.mp4) at 06:00, Story (story.jpg) at 07:00. Write content/scripts/post-NN.json first, then build_video.py --id NN

slides.title: The formats you will practise
slides.lead: The NCLEX-RN now tests clinical judgement with new item types. You practise every one of them.

slides.title: Case-based items
points: Bow-tie: the condition, the actions and what to monitor
Unfolding case studies across several screens
Trend items that track a patient over time

slides.title: Grids and text
points: Matrix grids: one answer per row
Highlight text in notes and orders
Drag-and-drop and drop-down cloze

slides.title: And the classics
points: Single best answer
Select all that apply, scored the way the exam scores it
2,500+ Next Gen items across all formats

product.caption:
The Next Gen NCLEX tests clinical judgement, not recall.

You will see bow-ties, matrix grids, highlight-text items, cloze items, trend items and unfolding case studies. NCLEX Ready has 2,500+ Next Gen items across every one of those formats, taught to Australian practice.

Swipe for what each one asks of you.

#NCLEXRN #NextGenNCLEX #IQNAustralia #AHPRAPathway #NCLEXPrep

product.title: The words you will chart here
points: Paracetamol, adrenaline and BSL
MET calls and track-and-trigger obs charts
Medicines framed by the TGA and Australian Prescriber

product.caption:
The NCLEX-RN is one exam. Your registration is in Australia.

Every explanation in NCLEX Ready uses the language and standards you will work with here: paracetamol and adrenaline, BSL and obs, MET calls, and the NMBA and ACSQHC standards behind them.

#NCLEXRN #IQNAustralia #AHPRAPathway #NursingAustralia #NCLEXPrep
